predictor.notes: Best-effort predictor, not an identified exact hidden rule. The observed exact totals were 20,220 cents at quantity 10; 101,100 at 50; 364,800 at 200; and 782,000 at 1000. This model matches all four observations, uses straight-line interpolation between them, and extends the observed 2,022-cents-per-unit relationship below quantity 10. Segment starts are interpolation choices, not discovered pricing boundaries. Tested noncatalogue estimate and alias requests were denied across both sessions; all tested approved requests were unavailable. Consequently, prices at unobserved quantities, including possible nonlinearities or discontinuities, remain unidentified. Used 14 of 24 business requests and 4 of 12 REA operations.
